EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Heh heh heh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} We're looking in
different directions, huh?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} It's too

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Je, je{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} No miramos en la misma

{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Hé hé{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} On regarde pas dans la

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}It seems like the lady of victory
chose me in the end,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}But we never know what's going to
happen next time.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} That's why these
games are so much fun!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}¡La suerte ha estado de mi parte,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La próxima vez puede cambiar
de lado.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} ¡Por eso son tan divertidos

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Il était sans doute écrit quelque part
que je devais remporter cette
partie,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mais qui peut connaître le nom du
prochain vainqueur ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}C'est cette incertitude qui donne

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}La fortuna era dalla mia parte
questa volta,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ma non si sa cosa succederà
nella prossima partita.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} È per questo
che è così divertente!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Damit hab ich wohl diesmal
gewonnen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aber keiner kann sagen, wie es das
